def.en: A person you like and trust, who is kind to you and enjoys spending time with you.
def.hg: Woh insaan jo tumhe pasand hai aur jis par tumhe trust hai, jo tumse pyaar se pesh aata hai aur tumhare saath time bitana pasand karta hai.

def.en: Using gentle words and actions that help other people feel good and safe.
def.hg: Aise gentle words aur kaam jinse doosre log achha aur safe feel karein.

def.en: Letting someone else use or enjoy something of yours for a while, like a toy or a snack.
def.hg: Apni koi cheez, jaise toy ya snack, thodi der ke liye kisi aur ko use karne ya enjoy karne dena.

def.en: Saying sorry when you have hurt someone, and trying not to do it again.
def.hg: Jab tumse kisi ko hurt ho toh sorry bolna, aur koshish karna ki dobara aisa na ho.

def.en: The space around your body that is yours. Others should ask before they come very close or touch you.
def.hg: Tumhari body ke aas-paas ki woh jagah jo tumhari apni hai. Bahut paas aane ya touch karne se pehle doosron ko poochna chahiye.

def.en: Feeling sure that someone will be kind to you, tell the truth and keep their promises.
def.hg: Yeh yakeen hona ki koi tumse pyaar se pesh aayega, sach bolega aur apna promise nibhayega.

def.en: A personal limit about what you are comfortable with, such as how you are touched, spoken to or contacted. Others should respect it.
def.hg: Ek personal limit ki tum kis cheez mein comfortable ho, jaise tumhe kaise touch kiya jaye, tumse kaise baat ki jaye ya kaise contact kiya jaye. Doosron ko iski respect karni chahiye.

def.en: A pattern of overwhelming attention, gifts and promises very early in a relationship, used to rush closeness or commitment and gain influence.
def.hg: Relationship ke bilkul shuru mein hi bahut zyada attention, gifts aur promises ka pattern, jiska use jaldi closeness ya commitment karwane aur influence jamane ke liye hota hai.

def.en: Repeatedly denying or twisting what happened so that a person starts doubting their own memory, feelings and judgement.
def.hg: Jo hua use baar-baar deny ya twist karna, taaki insaan apni hi memory, feelings aur judgement par doubt karne lage.

def.en: Treating a partner or friend as something owned: controlling who they meet, what they wear or how they spend their time.
def.hg: Partner ya dost ko apni property samajhna: yeh control karna ki woh kisse mile, kya pehne ya apna time kaise bitaye.

def.en: Getting someone to agree through pressure, guilt, threats or persistence instead of free choice. Agreement obtained this way is not real consent.
def.hg: Kisi se free choice ke bajaye pressure, guilt, dhamki ya baar-baar zid karke haan bulwana. Is tarah mila agreement real consent nahi hai.

def.en: A repeated pattern of insults, humiliation, threats, control or isolation that damages a person's confidence and sense of safety.
def.hg: Insults, humiliation, dhamkiyon, control ya isolation ka baar-baar ka pattern, jo insaan ke confidence aur safety ki feeling ko damage karta hai.
